items.title: Jackett
items.description: API Support for your favorite torrent trackers. An alternative to Prowlarr.

items.title: Prowlarr
items.description: An indexer manager/proxy built on the popular arr .net/reactjs base stack to integrate with your various PVR apps. Prowlarr supports management of both Torrent Trackers and Usenet Indexers. It integrates seamlessly with Lidarr, Mylar3, Radarr, and Sonarr offering complete management of your indexers with no per app Indexer setup required.
These serve as alternatives to the *arr ecosystem, offering similar automation and media management capabilities.

items.title: SoulSync
items.description: Intelligent Music Discovery & Automation Platform. Automates downloads, curates playlists, monitors artists, and organizes your collection.

items.title: Flexget
items.description: A multipurpose automation tool for all of your media. Support for torrents, nzbs, podcasts, comics, TV, movies, RSS, HTML, CSV, and more.

items.title: Mylar3
items.description: The python3 version of the automated Comic Book downloader (cbr/cbz) for use with various download clients.

items.title: Kapowarr
items.description: A software to build and manage a comic book library.

items.title: SickGear
items.description: The most reliable stable TV fork of the great Sick-Beard to fully automate TV enjoyment with innovation.

items.title: Questarr
items.description: Track and organize your video game collection with automated discovery and download management.

items.title: Beyond *arr
FlareSolverr
items.description: Proxy server to bypass Cloudflare protection.

items.title: Tdarr
items.description: Distributed transcode automation using FFmpeg/HandBrake + Audio/Video library analytics + video health checking.

items.title: Bazarr
items.description: A companion application to Sonarr and Radarr. It manages and downloads subtitles based on your requirements. You define your preferences by TV show or movie and Bazarr takes care of everything for you.

items.title: Ombi
items.description: A self-hosted web application that automatically gives your shared Plex or Emby users the ability to request content by themselves! Ombi can be linked to multiple TV Show and Movie DVR tools to create a seamless end-to-end experience for your users.

items.title: Kometa
items.description: An open source Python 3 project that has been designed to ease the creation and maintenance of metadata, collections, and playlists within a Plex Media Server.

items.title: Wizarr
items.description: An automatic user invitation system for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, AudiobookShelf, Komga, Kavita and Romm.

items.title: Tracearr
items.description: Real-time monitoring platform for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. Track streams, playback analytics, and account sharing detection in one place.

items.title: Cleanuparr
items.description: An advanced cleaner for dead or malicious torrents.

items.title: Reiverr
items.description: A clean combined interface for Jellyfin, TMDB, Radarr and Sonarr, as well as a replacement to Overseerr.

items.title: Maintainerr
items.description: Looks and smells like Seerr, does the opposite. A library maintenance tool for Plex and Jellyfin.

items.title: Recyclarr
items.description: Automatically sync TRaSH guides to your Sonarr and Radarr instances.

items.title: Byparr
items.description: An alternative to FlareSolverr as a drop-in replacement, built with seleniumbase and FastAPI.

items.title: Radarr-striptracks
items.description: A Docker Mod for the LinuxServer.io Radarr/Sonarr v3 Docker container that adds a script to automatically strip out unwanted audio and subtitle streams, keeping only the desired languages.

items.title: Unpackerr
items.description: Extracts downloads for Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Readarr, and/or a Watch folder - Deletes extracted files after import.

items.title: Arr-scripts
items.description: Extended Container Scripts. Designed to be easily implemented/added to Linuxserver.io containers.

items.title: Midarr
items.description: The minimal lightweight media server.

items.title: SuggestArr
items.description: Automatic media content recommendations and download requests based on user activity on the media server.

items.title: Ezarr
items.description: Aims to make it as easy as possible to setup an entire Servarr/Jackett/BitTorrent/PleX/Jellyfin mediacenter stack using Docker.

items.title: Soularr
items.description: A Python script that connects Lidarr with Soulseek.

items.title: Posterizarr
items.description: Automated poster maker for Plex/Jellyfin/Emby.

items.title: Decluttarr
items.description: Watches radarr, sonarr, lidarr and whisparr download queues and removes downloads if they become stalled or no longer needed.

items.title: Lingarr
items.description: Integrates with Radarr and Sonarr and automates subtitle translation using various locally hosted or SaaS translation services.

items.title: Exportarr

items.title: Deployrr

items.title: Managarr

items.title: Janitorr
items.description: Cleans your Radarr, Sonarr, Jellyseerr and Jellyfin before you run out of space.

items.title: Pulsarr
items.description: An integration tool that bridges Plex watchlists with Sonarr and Radarr, enabling real-time media monitoring and automated content acquisition all from within the Plex App itself.

items.title: Trawl
items.description: Another drop-in replacement alternative to FlareSolverr which uses Invisible Playwright to bypass captchas of various types.

items.title: Monitorr
items.description: A self-hosted PHP web app that monitors the status of local and remote network services, websites, and applications.

items.title: Autoscan

items.title: Posterr
items.description: A digital poster app for Plex, Sonarr and Radarr.

items.description: Scans your library files for corrupt media and replace the files via sonarr and radarr.

items.description: An automated lightweight service that updates media servers like Plex and Jellyfin based on notifications from media organizers like Sonarr and Radarr.

items.title: Trailarr
items.description: A Docker application to download and manage trailers for your Radarr, and Sonarr libraries.

items.title: Scraparr
items.description: This will generate Prometheus Metrics gathered from various *arr and *arr-stack applications.

items.title: Nixarr
items.description: A Nixos module that aims to make the installation and management of a home media server as easy, and pain free, as possible.

items.title: MediathekArr
items.description: Integrate ARD&ZDF Mediathek in Prowlarr, Sonarr, and Radarr (German free public TV stations).

items.title: Buildarr
items.description: A solution to automating deployment and configuration of your *arr stack.

items.title: Watchlistarr

items.title: Flemmarr
items.description: Easy, automatic configuration for your -arr apps.

items.title: Deleterr

items.title: Prefetcharr

items.title: Digarr
items.description: AI-powered music discovery that builds a taste profile from your listening sources and finds new artists. Optionally sends approved artists straight to Lidarr.

items.title: Listrr
items.description: Creates lists for shows and movies based on your filters. The created lists get updated every 24 hours based on your filters, so Listrr will add all new items that match your filters, and will also remove all items that do not match your filter configuration anymore. Supports Sonarr, Radarr, Traktarr and Python-PlexLibrary.

items.title: Posteria
items.description: A sleek, modern solution for managing your movie, TV show, and collection posters.

items.title: Toolbarr

items.title: Gclone
items.description: A rclone mod with auto SA rotation.

items.title: Quasarr
items.description: Connects JDownloader with Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr and LazyLibrarian. It also decrypts links protected by CAPTCHAs.

items.title: Muxarr
items.description: Optimize and clean up your media library by stripping redundant audio tracks and subtitles without re-encoding. Features *arr integration for original language detection and automatic processing, with an easy-to-use web interface to preview changes.

items.title: Episeerr
items.description: Automates sending and deleting episodes or seasons to sonarr one at a time as played.

items.title: iPlayarr

items.title: Transcoderr

items.title: Crossarr
items.description: Cross Seed via Arr Programs.
